items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: George Zack, for example, people like that... And about then, Zack came to New York, George Zack. And the boss at the Pirate's Den was very fascinated with him. And he just dreamt about having the two of us.

ctx.x: But the people that liked to play for kicks and
enjoyed it would come down. George Zack, for example, people like that. Some black players, too. I can't remember all their names.
